params.method: 同じ台帳でEVL-20261123-022891を含めない状態（登録前の python3 tools/belief_state.py --question Q-001 --json）と、含めた状態を比較した。後者では対象のlog_oddsが1.38下がり、指定した子のlog_oddsが0.90上がった。source setのいずれも有限窓の大きさ・身体費用通貨・AIの検索を操作していないため、その算術移動は人間研究の測定結果ではない。
params.scope_test: EVL summary itself states that the materials do not test the finite-window/cost-currency or AI claims; its qualitative boundary remains readable, but the automatic posterior movement is not identified by these sources.

claim: 今回の人間研究10件が有限注意窓・身体的費用通貨・AI側を直接検定していないにもかかわらず、この質的な射程限定に通常の信念更新重みを与え、既存子仮説への確率移転まで妥当化してよい。
measured_now: BELIEF_MAP arithmetic with the EVL changes Q-001 P for HYP-20261119-539a0c from 45.66% to 60.90%, HYP-20261119-63b6bf from 33.80% to 11.34%, and HYP-20261120-58ddce from 0.19% to 0.63%. These are engine outputs caused by a narrowing row and its named inheritor, not outcomes measured by the human studies. The source set does not discriminate the pair on the resource-window or delegation mechanism.
note: EVL-20261123-022891 remains as a qualitative record that human future-self outcomes require task/measure/self-relevance conditions. This correction voids only its unsupported ordinary numerical weight and inheritance transfer; it does not withdraw any paper, material, or reading. Keep the non-extrapolation and measurement-boundary conclusions visible.
